findings.topic: Composition and visual continuity of the established style
findings.finding: Across all five inspected sheets, the luminous city, reflective floor, stars, church architecture, blue figures, gold instruments, and colored trails remain visually coherent. No unexpected blank frame, obvious full-frame corruption, or abrupt rectangular mask was observed in these sampled images.

The sampled holds of Sacrifice, Devotion, This hope was engraved / deep in all our hearts, All kings worship You, to the great Church of God!, Joy of salvation!, and Wondrous love are legible at contact-sheet scale, with complete phrases contained within the picture.

Some before/after-cut samples show deliberately incomplete-looking reveal or particle-dissolve states. Neighboring hold samples show the complete intended phrase. These stills are consistent with a text transition rather than a persistently clipped hold; they do not establish continuous transition timing.

The sampled conductor has a distinct blue coat/trouser silhouette, the ceremonial figures retain long robe silhouettes, and the choir remains faceless blue light figures with gold books. The gold instrument groups are recognizable as an orchestra. No exposed or realistic anatomical detail was apparent at this review scale.

findings.topic: Strong bloom reduces local fine detail
findings.finding: The 109.917–110.000 second city samples have strong white bloom that reduces fine architectural detail. Additional bright city samples occur at 161.817 and 165.283 seconds. Larger architecture and scene layout remain recognizable, and later samples restore contrast. This is a visible aesthetic tradeoff, not a diagnosed encoding or masking defect.

At frame 11232 / 187.2 seconds, the bright conducting ribbon passes across part of love in Wondrous love. The phrase remains readable; neighboring samples at 186.033 and 188.350 seconds show a clearer title. The overlay is noticeable and could be reduced in a future creative revision if completely unobstructed text is preferred.

limitations: Inspection used all 120 tiles on sheets 05–09. No new full-resolution frame inspection was performed for this final-master scoped review.
